description_expanded: ABOUT COMMODORES RETREAT-101: Experience unparalleled beachfront living in this exquisite 1-bedroom condo nestled in the Commodores Retreat complex in Seagrove Beach. Situated on the second story, this end unit occupies a prime location at the eastern end of the building, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico and the serene eastern lake. The condo features a spacious and tastefully decorated interior, designed for both comfort and style. Step outside onto the private balcony and revel in the soothing sound of the waves crashing on the shore while enjoying the spectacular vistas that stretch as far as the eye can see. Whether you're seeking a romantic getaway or a peaceful retreat, this gulf-front condo in Seagrove Beach promises an unforgettable coastal experience. ABOUT THE AREA: Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community located along Scenic Highway 30A in the Florida Panhandle. Situated between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, Seagrove Beach epitomizes the laid-back and picturesque beach lifestyle that the area is known for. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, emerald green waters, and towering sand dunes, Seagrove Beach offers a serene and relaxed ambiance that attracts visitors looking for a peaceful getaway. The beach in Seagrove is perfect for swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and simply enjoying the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. In addition to its beautiful beach, Seagrove Beach is surrounded by natural beauty, including rare coastal dune lakes, pine forests, and state parks. Visitors can explore hiking and biking trails, go birdwatching, or take a leisurely walk along the scenic coastline to appreciate the area s unique ecosystem. Seagrove Beach is also home to a variety of charming beach cottages, luxury vacation rentals, boutique shops, and delicious restaurants serving fresh seafood and local cuisine. The community has a laid-back and friendly vibe, making it a favorite destination for families, couples, and outdoor enthusiasts looking to unwind and reconnect with nature. Along Scenic Highway 30A, visitors can explore neighboring beach communities, each with its own distinct character and amenities. From art galleries and coastal dune lakes to live music events and farmers markets, there is always something to see and do along this scenic stretch of coastline. Overall, Seagrove Beach is a hidden gem along Scenic Highway 30A, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty, relaxation, and Southern hospitality that captures the essence of the Florida Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Directly behind Commodores 101 PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Beach chair service included. (2 chairs & 1 umbrella) * 1 minute walk to the beach * Building includes an elevator * Amazing gulf views PARKING: * Free Parking up to 1 Vehicle PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation. * Must be 25 years old to rent. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.
